description: Batch preflight for a go-live check or an ERP regression suite: per-document verdicts, readiness percentage, the most frequent rejection rules across the batch, optional printable HTML. Charged per document. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix_hint, source = xsd | schematron | preflight), counts, ruleset version and timings, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Documents are validated in memory and never stored or logged.
